_comment: Connectors the plugin declares. Remote servers (atlassian, figma) are matched to an existing connection by URL; entries with an empty url are matched by NAME to the host's connector directory (first-party connectors whose endpoint is dynamic). Tableau is deliberately NOT declared — it is a local MCP server the user runs themselves (see README → Plugin components). Tool namespaces observed per server live in references/integration-strategy.md → Declared connectors.
